name: gity
$comment: ADR-006 — vcpkg carries the small C libraries on Windows and macOS. Qt is NOT here: building it from source costs hours per cold CI run and diverges from the binaries Qt supports. Linux uses system packages. Pin builtin-baseline to a real vcpkg commit before the first Windows/macOS build.

dependencies.name: libgit2
dependencies.$comment: pcre2 is not optional: with default-features off, libgit2's port fails outright with 'Must choose pcre or pcre2 regex backend'. ssh gives us libssh2 for the fetch/push paths libgit2 still handles.
